cd api-java && mvn compile -pl dify-api-boot passes

steps: cd api-java && mvn test-compile -pl dify-api-boot succeeds

tasks.description: Both ConsoleBootstrapContractTest and ConsoleFeatureContractTest extend AbstractIntegrationTest, removing their own @SpringBootTest and @ActiveProfiles annotations (inherited from base).
steps: cd api-java && mvn test-compile -pl dify-api-boot passes
